ios.desc:
Build-A-Bookie is where your crew keeps score and makes it fun with friendly bets.

Spin up a book for golf, bowling, pickup basketball, a league season, or a custom challenge with friends. Post picks tied to real stats, enter scores, and watch bets settle automatically. Virtual stakes, real bragging rights. No real money, ever.

PERFECT FOR
• Golf foursomes and side games
• Bowling league nights
• Pickup teams and rec leagues
• Custom group challenges
• Solo goals when you want to bet on yourself

HOW IT WORKS
1. Start a book: invite your crew in one tap
2. Post bets on the next event: everyone picks a side
3. Enter scores: stats update, bets grade, standings move

EVERY BOOK HAS THREE SURFACES
• Clubhouse: what’s next, who’s leading, open bets
• Live: the current event, schedule, and action
• Log: history, money flow, and your crew’s record

STATS THAT STICK
Every bet ties to a score in your permanent record. Track performance over time, climb live leaderboards, and build a Star profile that follows you across books — wins, losses, streaks, and the stats you actually care about.

BUILT FOR FRIENDS, NOT STRANGERS
Private books with the people you play with. No sportsbook. No strangers. No deposits or cashouts; just competition, leaderboards, and talk-you-smack-in-the-group-chat energy.

ENTERTAINMENT ONLY
Build-A-Bookie uses virtual money for fun. No real-money wagering, no prizes, no withdrawals.

Terms of Use: https://www.build-a-bookie.com/terms
